why: `sync(d>0)` pushes the sentinel from `present` as well as from `absent`, which turns the single-entry design into an entry per layer AND a further entry per in-app pop that leaves layers open. The player then presses the browser's Back once per pushed entry to leave, and the traversals the design bounds to one at a time pile up. Fails 3 of 15 in navigation.test.ts: `the first layer pushes exactly one sentinel and a second layer pushes none`, `an in-app pop with a layer remaining touches history not at all; emptying the stack retires the sentinel with one back()`, and `a browser Back at depth 2 pops one layer and re-pushes the sentinel through the re-entrant sync; at depth 1 pops one and pushes nothing`, each at an exact `host.calls` list.
